arStrings.szText:
Damaging {c_random}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} Enemies with {c_important}Storm{/c} Skills grants a charge. Casting any Defensive Skill will grant Max Movement Speed and {c_important}Unhindered{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} second for each charge used. 

While Charged, enemies you run into are {c_important}Immobilized{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} second.
